statements.subject: server
statements.description: For backward-compatibility, if the Content-Disposition header field is missing, the server SHOULD assume bodies of Content-Type application/sdp are the disposition "session", while other content types are "render".
statements.post_cond: (message.Content-Type = application/sdp & message.body.assumed_disposition = session) | (message.Content-Type != application/sdp & message.body.assumed_disposition = render)
actions: Assume Content-Type application/sdp message bodies have disposition 'session'
Assume all other content types have disposition 'render'

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the handling parameter is missing, the value "required" SHOULD be assumed.
